known_differences_from_fetch_script: Larceny coverage is partial: the only larceny code in the pull is 23F THEFT FROM MOTOR VEHICLE (3,552 rows; no 23A-23E, 23G or 23H rows) per evidence/raw_cache_profile.json ucr_code distinct values. Raw 23F rows per IncidentYear are 771/736/794/784/467 for 2021-2025 against official larceny 2450/2150/2329/2599/2155 (evidence/official_totals.csv), about 31%/34%/34%/30%/22% (query: SELECT IncidentYear, count(*) FROM raw_cache WHERE trim(ucr_code)='23F' GROUP BY 1). The rule lists 23A-23H so any other larceny codes the feed adds later map, but the reconciled larceny total will fall far short of the official figure.

The feed publishes a selected set of NIBRS codes only (09A, 11A-11D, 120, 13A, 13C, 220, 23F, 240, 290, 35A, 35B, 520, 99XX; evidence/raw_cache_profile.json); there is no simple assault, arson, or other larceny subtype, and the portal metadata (evidence/doc_00.json) has an empty description and states no selection rule.

Count unit is one row per offense code per incident: OCA|ucr_code is unique over all 21,815 rows while OCA has 18,411 distinct values (query: count(DISTINCT OCA||'|'||ucr_code) = 21815). An incident carrying, e.g., robbery and aggravated assault is counted under both offenses, unlike the SRS hierarchy rule; SRS rape and aggravated assault are also victim-based, so counts differ from the official unit.

Aggravated assault (13A) raw rows are 337/319/341/328/279 for 2021-2025 against official 440/437/488/443/341 (about 77%/73%/70%/74%/82%), consistent with incident-offense rows versus victim-based official counts. The 13A rows carry arr_chrg sub-codes 13A, 13AP, 13ARR, 13K, 13O and CDV variants, all described as AGGRAVATED ASSAULT; all are kept.

Rape uses 11A, 11B and 11C (revised SRS definition); 11D SEX OFFENSE/ CRIMINAL SEXUAL CONTACT (228 rows) is fondling and is left out. Raw 11A+11B+11C rows are 65/44/40/41/32 for 2021-2025 against official 76/54/44/44/32.
One row has ucr_code '13C ' (intimidation) with ChargeDescription 'AGGRAVATED ASSAULT / FIREARM' and arr_chrg '13A'; the rules follow ucr_code and leave it out as intimidation.

No rows exist before 2021: DateOccurred minimum is 1609459200000 (2021-01-01T00:00Z) and IncidentYear ranges 2021-2025 (evidence/raw_cache_profile.json), so 2018-2020 official totals have no counterpart in this feed.
notes: Charleston Police Department (municipal_pd, ORI SC0100100) polices the City of Charleston, the single scope candidate 45:municipal:place:4513330 (evidence/scope_candidates.csv, evidence/registry_row.json). Offenses are mapped on the published NIBRS field ucr_code (values carry a trailing space, e.g. '13A ', so rules use anchored regex tolerant of whitespace; the runner's eq/in do not trim). Codes present and mapped, with pull counts: 09A 48, 11A 177, 11B 30, 11C 15, 120 373, 13A 1604, 220 1194, 23F 3552, 240 1981 (evidence/raw_cache_profile.json; the ChargeDescription values agree with each code, see query grouping ucr_code by ChargeDescription). Left out: 11D (fondling), 13C (intimidation, 1 row), 35A/35B/520/290/99XX (drug and weapon law). Count unit is offense: id is OCA|ucr_code, which is unique in the pull (21,815 distinct of 21,815 rows), so dedupe_on_id removes nothing on the archive and keeps one row per offense code per incident; where an incident has several offense codes, each mapped code is kept as its own row. Date is the occurrence date DateOccurred (esriFieldTypeDate, epoch ms, UTC per dateFieldsTimeReference in evidence/doc_00.json). Every value is at 00:00:00 UTC (DateOccurred % 86400000 = 0 for all rows) and TimeOccurred is entirely null, so it is a date-only field and the year from DateOccurred equals IncidentYear on every row (query cross-tab of year(to_timestamp(DateOccurred/1000)) by IncidentYear: 4072/4522/4606/4303/4312 for 2021-2025, no off-diagonal rows). Coordinates are the feature point geometry (__arcgis_latitude/__arcgis_longitude; layer is esriGeometryPoint in Web Mercator 102100, evidence/doc_00.json); all 21,815 rows have a point, within lon -80.178 to -79.813 and lat 32.686 to 33.019. The publisher does not state any rounding or offset of points; StreetAddress is masked to the hundred block (e.g. '1XX N ROMNEY ST'), but the points are not collapsed to one per masked address (7,796 distinct 6-decimal points versus 3,541 distinct addresses), so the point precision cannot be settled from the evidence. The where clause is the registry probe_where, which is the filter the archive was pulled under (packet.json case_text). The publisher states no redactions or exclusions (registry_row.json redactions empty; layer description empty in doc_00.json). Raw per-year counts for robbery (88/72/82/68/63), burglary (273/247/264/224/186), motor vehicle theft (470/496/447/341/227) and murder (16/8/9/7/8) track the official totals closely for 2021-2025; larceny is theft-from-motor-vehicle only and will reconcile at roughly a third of the official figure.
